name: minimum incoming edge per node with cycle contraction
mechanism: for every node keep its cheapest incoming edge; if the chosen edges form a cycle, contract the cycle into one node with adjusted edge costs and repeat; expanding the contractions yields a minimum spanning arborescence

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Edmonds' algorithm (also known as Chu–Liu/Edmonds' algorithm)' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Graph algorithms / Routing for graphs: find maximum or minimum branchings

fails_when: cycle contraction bookkeeping dominates the implementation
instances: Edmonds' algorithm (also known as Chu–Liu/Edmonds' algorithm)
